items.title: Skyblock Fragments
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Skyblock!
Play the classic game mode alone or with your friends!

- Can you manage the challenge?
- By Team Ethyria

items.title: Bed Wars Pros
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Defend your bed with all your might! Choose from 8 different skins with expert tools and weapons. Master the command blocks you need to keep sleeping and respawning. Role-play as a real pro and keep your bed safe from harm. Don’t let anyone destroy your bed!

1 free skin included!

items.title: TV Heads
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Time to tune in and enjoy the show. Role-play as a magnificent machine wonder with a television for a head. Choose from 12 different skins with color and black and white screens. Channel a signal and show off awesome HD technology!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Stylish Dogs
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
No shaggy dogs here! Role-play in super chic styles while you bark and howl and chase your tail. Choose from 12 cool canine skins of different breeds. Dress up in colorful and trendy fashions, formal and casual. Have your best day ever!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Astronauts vs Aliens
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
They say weird things happen in outer space. When you role-play with friends in Astronauts vs Aliens skins, you can create a really awesome adventure. Gear up as a brave space traveler in protective suit and helmet. Become a strange, unearthly being ready to defend your world from unwelcome visitors. 

+ 8 space voyager HD skins

items.title: Winter Mobs
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Gear up for some arctic adventures! Role-play as your favorite frosty mobile entities in Winter Mobs skins. Look like icy blue skeletons, zombies, or piglins. Try out winter white fur on a glacial goat ready to butt heads and horns. It’s time to welcome wintertime!

+ 7 cold but cool HD skins

items.title: Time Travelers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
From the past or the future? Look like an ancient tourist or super modern visitor in Time Travelers skins. Role-play with friends as futuristic explorers researching life in today’s world. Become a wanderer from a time long ago and be amazed by what you see!

+ 8 olden times or coming times HD skins

items.title: Robo Cops
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Are these the police of the future? Gear up in plenty of heavy duty armor and helmets with Robo Cops skins. Role-play with friends as you work to keep the peace and enforce the law. Enjoy total protection with leg and arm shields, vests, and screens for your face and eyes. Become a modern, crime-fighting machine!

+ 8 cyborg officer HD skins

items.title: Glitch Mobs
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
What happens when mobs spawn, and something goes wrong? Imperfections and flaws appear, like in Glitch Mobs skins. Role-play with friends as not-quite-right hoglins, skeletons, and zombies. Just a little bit off, make everyone blink to be sure you really are a ghast, creeper, or Ender Dragon. You might be faulty, but you’re still hostile.

+ 8 malfunctioning mobs HD skins

items.title: City Roleplay
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
The city never sleeps because the people keep it moving. In the town center and every neighborhood, become a real urban slicker in City Role Play skins. Minecraft becomes modern when you role-play with friends as business people, lawyers, or stockbrokers. Work hard and be successful, then play hard and have fun in a cool cityscape.

+ 8 super city dweller HD skins

items.title: Mongol Empire
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Go way back in time when you role-play with friends in Mongol Empire skins. Act like you live in an ancient kingdom and become an emperor or empress to rule like true royalty. Look like a humble peasant, tending to the needs of your fellow tribe members. Long live the empire!

+ 8 nomadic people HD skins

items.title: Techno Elves
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Enjoy the holidays in very modern style. Dress up in super cyber outfits with Techno Elves skins. Take on a digital look when you role-play with friends in cool wired patterns and elflike horns. Have fun with new and different fashions to celebrate all the season’s festivities.

+ 8 chic sprite HD skins

items.title: Baby Dress-Up
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
It’s really hard to be a cry baby in darling onesies and cute pajamas. Role-play with friends as a newborn in diapers, infant, or toddler in Baby Dress-Up skins. With a bottle or pacifier, soothe yourself and take a long, peaceful nap. Wake up to walk some first steps and make babble your first words. You’re growing up fast!

+ 8 adorable tots HD skins

items.title: Armored Gang
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Time to conquer the world! Role-play with friends as ancient nomadic people in Armored Gang skins. Look like powerful warriors ready to expand the empire with proper armor and swords. Become part of the tribe’s royalty in elegant outfits fit for life in a castle. Victory is yours!

+ 8 fierce fighter HD skins

items.title: Abstract
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Look sharp in the most colorful combinations of shape, form, and color. You’re like a painting come to life in Abstract skins. Role-play with friends as visual, non-figurative artwork that may astound any viewer. Walk around town and look like you just stepped off of a contemporary gallery or museum wall.

+ 8 modern art HD skins

items.title: Ninja Rabbits
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Tuck in your long ears and put on a mask and cape! Disguise yourself as you sneak around the city in Ninja Rabbits skins. Leap into and out of the shadows as you role-play and hide with furry friends. Conduct secret spy missions as you silently hop and jump, ready to use the katana on your back. These are some bad bunnies!

+ 8 hushed hare HD skins

items.title: Crystal Camo
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Sparkle and shine in spiky Crystal Camo skins. Role-play with friends and gear up as colorful creatures with jagged crystal-like features. Look like a shard or cluster of prismarine or amethyst. Put on the perfect cover of ruby or turquoise and blend into the mines.

+ 8 crystal textured HD skins

items.title: Baby Boom
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Tick, tock, the clock is running. Time to explode with cuteness all over Minecraft in Baby Boom skins. Gear up in a dynamite look when you role-play with friends as incendiary infants. Put a pacifier in your mouth and create a smashing scene in red TNT pajamas or onesie. The perfect way to release all of your terrific toddler energy.

+ 8 baby bomb HD skins

items.title: Fairies
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Flit and fly from flower to flower in lovely Fairies skins. Dancing through the air with wonderful wings, role-play with friends as mythical charming creatures. More than just a pretty face, try out your magical powers and sprinkle fairy dust all around Minecraft. Enchant and delight in your favorite realm, the world of nature.

+ 8 shimmering sprite HD skins

items.title: Pastel Autumn
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
The weather is getting colder, so it's time to bundle up! These teens are ready for the fall season and know how to look stylish. Enjoy a cool breezy day with a pumpkin spice latte, chatting with friends, or taking a stroll around the city while looking the very best!

- 20 Autumn-themed Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Black & White Masks
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: These shadows are mischievous and wear masks to hide their true intentions! They have cool designs though and which help to tell apart from each other! Become a sneaky shadow and join them in their trickster games!

items.title: Realistic Mobs HD
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Introducing Realistic Mobs, all your favorite vanilla Minecraft mobs are completely reimagined. Step into your next journey as a high-definition creeper, a scary realistic zombie, or defend villages dressed like an epic iron golem! 

~Traditional textures turned into high-resolution skins!
~10 custom designs
~By Entity Builds

items.title: Smiling Monsters
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
These awesome crazy smiling mobs skins are ready for role-playing and adventure.
Equip 1 of these and be awesome!

items.title: Masked Anime Teens
items.creator: Duh
items.description:
Masks never go out of trend! Get your masked costume today from Masked Anime Teens collection.

- 21 trendy skins
- by DUH
